trips.name: Land's End to Edinburgh, west side
trips.note: The classic end-to-end line: Cornwall, Exeter, Bath and Bristol, the Welsh Marches, Lancashire, Cumbria, the Borders
trips.why: the crossing everyone rides: quiet Shropshire lanes, the Lakes at your elbow, the Borders hills into Edinburgh

trips.name: Land's End to Edinburgh via London
trips.note: The east-side line: Dorset and Wessex into London, the Lee Valley, Cambridge and the Fens, York, Durham, the Northumberland coast
trips.why: the only end-to-end that passes through the capital; flat through the Fens, then NCN 1 up the east coast

trips.name: Land's End to London
trips.note: Cornwall, Dartmoor's edge, the Jurassic coast hinterland, Salisbury, Winchester, the Surrey hills into town
trips.why: a week's ride to the capital with the wind behind you

trips.name: London to Edinburgh
trips.note: Lee Valley, Cambridge, Lincoln, York, Durham, Newcastle, the Northumberland coast and Berwick
trips.why: capital to capital; the east-coast line that LEL and the Sustrans NCN 1 both follow

trips.name: Richmond Park loop
trips.sub: Ealing Broadway → Richmond Park → Ealing Broadway
trips.note: Kew Bridge, Roehampton Gate, the park road, back along the river
trips.why: the everyday loop from Ealing: deer, the park road, the Thames back

trips.name: Hampton Court and back
trips.sub: Ealing Broadway → Hampton Court → Ealing Broadway
trips.note: Thames path through Richmond and Kingston to the palace

trips.name: Windsor along the river
trips.note: Thames path to Hampton Court, Staines, the Jubilee River into Windsor; train back
trips.why: flat all the way, castle at the end

trips.name: Chilterns loop
trips.sub: Ealing Broadway → Beaconsfield → Marlow → Windsor → Ealing Broadway
trips.note: Out over the Chiltern edge to Marlow, down the Thames to Windsor, home along the river
trips.why: the best hilly day from Ealing without a train

trips.name: Grand Union to Rickmansworth
trips.note: Towpath all the way: Bull's Bridge, Uxbridge, the Colne valley lakes

trips.name: Box Hill and back
trips.sub: Ealing Broadway → Box Hill → Ealing Broadway
trips.note: Kingston, Leatherhead, the Zig Zag Road; the 2012 Olympic climb
trips.why: London's climb: every club rides it

trips.name: Thames path
trips.note: Kingston, Richmond, Putney, the Embankment, Tower Bridge, Greenwich
trips.why: the whole of London from the water, car-free most of the way

trips.name: Regent's Canal
trips.note: Camden, King's Cross, Islington, Victoria Park, Limehouse Basin
trips.why: the classic towpath through the middle of town

trips.name: Lee Valley
trips.note: Olympic Park, the reservoirs, Waltham Abbey, Broxbourne, Ware
trips.why: the flat way out of London to Hertfordshire

trips.name: London to Brighton
trips.note: Redhill, the Weald, Ditchling Beacon, the sea
trips.why: the charity classic: 90 km, one big hill, the sea

trips.name: Epping Forest
trips.note: Lee Valley to the forest edge, the forest road to Epping

trips.name: Waterlink Way
trips.note: The Ravensbourne and the Pool river up to the Crystal Palace ridge

trips.name: Wandle Trail
trips.note: Wandsworth, Merton Abbey Mills, Morden Hall Park, Carshalton ponds

trips.name: London to Cambridge
trips.note: Lee Valley, Hertford, the Cam valley into Cambridge
trips.why: the other classic day out of town, flat and fast

trips.name: Osterley Park, Syon Park and Brentford
trips.note: Two National Trust parks and the Grand Union at Brentford; out and back along the same quiet route
trips.why: Osterley House and Syon Park back to back, then the river at Brentford — the closest proper parkland ride from Ealing

trips.name: Strand-on-the-Green
trips.note: Kew Bridge and along the towpath to the Georgian riverside terrace at Strand-on-the-Green; pubs on the water

trips.name: Northala Fields and Horsenden Hill
trips.sub: Ealing Broadway loop via Hanwell, Northala Fields, Horsenden Hill, Perivale
trips.note: Hanwell locks, the Wembley-rubble hills of Northala Fields, ancient Horsenden Hill; back the same quiet way
trips.why: the Ealing Cycling Campaign's own circular: two proper hills and a lot of green space without leaving the borough

trips.name: Take to the Hills
trips.sub: Ealing Broadway loop via Northala Fields, Harrow-on-the-Hill, Horsenden Hill
trips.note: The three-hills version: Northala Fields, up to Harrow-on-the-Hill for the view, then Horsenden Hill; back the same way
trips.why: west London's answer to a hilly day out — three summits and none of them far from home

trips.name: Uxbridge along the canal
trips.note: The Grand Union towpath as far as Uxbridge and back — half the Rickmansworth ride, same quiet water
trips.why: the shorter version of the canal ride, for when Rickmansworth is more than you fancy
